get.description: Narrows a user's entry payouts. An omitted field applies no constraint.

parameters.name: ripId
parameters.description: Only return payouts for this rip.

parameters.name: revealed
parameters.description: Only return payouts with this reveal state.

get.description: Rips the backend has settled, most recently settled first. The order is by settlement time, not by rip id, so a rip that finished on chain earlier can appear later in the feed. Pass userAddress to narrow the feed to rips that address bought entries in.

How many finished rips the given address took part in, split into claimed and refunded. Counts distinct rips over the same set the finished feed returns, so a rip the chain has finished with is only counted once the backend has settled it.

Returns the referral state of the calling user. An address with no on-chain referral activity yet is not an error: the response is a zero state, with empty rewards and period, and the fee falling back to the global default referral fee.

fee.description: Referral fee in basis points. Falls back to the global default referral fee when the referrer has no tier progress or custom fee yet.

startTime.description: Start of the current referral period. Null until the referrer records their first on-chain volume.

volume.description: Volume referred during the current period, as a base-unit integer string. "0" for a referrer with no on-chain activity.

available.description: Rewards withdrawable now, as a base-unit integer string. "0" for a referrer with no on-chain activity.

withdrawn.description: Rewards already withdrawn, as a base-unit integer string. "0" for a referrer with no on-chain activity.
